definitions.explanation: Contains no sugar. Commonly seen on food and beverage labels.

examples.japanese: {無糖|むとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'll have an unsweetened coffee, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無糖|むとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Sugar-free beverages are popular these days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{無糖|むとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヨーグルト→ヨーグルト：11133_yooguruto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{食|た}べている→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: For my health, I eat unsweetened yogurt every morning.

notes:
Commonly seen on product labels for food and beverages. Modifies nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMPOUND: ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + {糖|とう} (sugar)

SUGAR LEVEL LABELS:
- {無糖|むとう}: sugar-free
- ⟦{微糖|びとう}→微糖：19896_bitou⟧: slightly sweet (common for canned coffee)
- {低糖|ていとう}: low sugar
- ⟦{加糖|かとう}→加糖：20005_katou⟧: sugar added

SIMILAR {無|む}～ LABELS:
- ⟦{無塩|むえん}→無塩：28595_muen⟧: salt-free
- {無脂肪|むしぼう}: fat-free
- ⟦{無添加|むてんか}→無添加：19283_mutenka⟧: additive-free
- ⟦{無農薬|むのうやく}→無農薬：19133_munouyaku⟧: pesticide-free

USAGE:
Very common in convenience stores and supermarkets. {無糖|むとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧ and {無糖|むとう}⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧ are staples of Japanese vending machines.
